PC24-027 - Laurel Creek Condominiums
A request for a Condominium Housing Permit, Site Development Plan, and Tentative Subdivision Map for 71 single-family, detached condominiums in the RM-15 and RM-21 zones and located immediately east of Grapevine Road and west of Durian Street (APNs: 166-080-16, -18, -19, -65, -83, and 166-110-40, -41).
RECOMMENDATION:
Adopt Resolution 2014- , approving a Mitigated Negative Declaration for 71 single family detached condominiums located immediately east of Grapevine Road and west of Durian Street.
Adopt Resolution 2014- , approving a Condominium Housing Permit, Site Development Plan, and Tentative Subdivision Map for 71 single-family detached condominiums located immediately east of Grapevine Road and west of Durian Street.
PC14-299 - Santa Fe Vista Apartments
A request for a Site Development Plan for 114 multi-family apartment units and associated site improvements located at 1375 S. Santa Fe Avenue within the M-U (21) zone.
RECOMMENDATION:
Adopt Resolution 2014- , certifying the project Environmental Impact Report, adopting Environmental Findings and a Statement of Overriding Considerations pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act, and adopting a Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program for 114 multi-family apartment units and associated site improvements at 1375 S. Santa Fe Avenue.
Adopt Resolution 2014- , approving a Site Development Plan for 114 multi-family apartment units and associated site improvements at 1375 S. Santa Fe Avenue.
